data.comment: Audit outcome (2026-08-30): Ready to close: No. Full test suite fails intermittently under parallel load. Direct evidence at HEAD b32e73d: 1/522 tests failed — GymSwarm.test.ts AC3 (line 346, toBeGreaterThan assertion). The bounded tick poll (160 ticks) does not always allow the swarm bullet to reach the player under CPU load. Same class of timing-sensitive assertion as the original GymScout issue. The claimed fix (e48b046) did not fully resolve suite-level flakiness. A critical test-failure child was triaged: AH-0MTFU1GAO009KDBM. Item demoted to open/plan_complete. The item description also lacks formal Acceptance Criteria headings (ACs could not be extracted).
